title: Wizard101 operations, legacy teachers and native replacements
basis: Local source and installed Pet Dance review, 2026-11-08. Plans do not grant runtime readiness.

capabilities.title: Operation registry and bounded scheduler
capabilities.needed: Typed jobs, pinned backend versions, durable receipts, cancellation, dependency and resource admission. Keep operation scheduling separate from reaction timing.

capabilities.title: One selected target and input owner
capabilities.needed: Unify native, hub and old queue ownership across installed/portable instances; verify release and desktop takeover. Existing locks are separate.

capabilities.title: Shared frames and synchronized input evidence
capabilities.needed: One target-bound capture stream, timestamps, odd-dimension handling, bounded fan-out and actual dispatch alignment.

capabilities.title: Calibrated visual states and matching
capabilities.needed: Reusable window-relative ROI, scaling, multiple-match and unknown-state contracts; compare alternatives on held-out frames.

capabilities.title: Visual waits, branches and recovery
capabilities.needed: Bounded wait/branch/repeat/call steps over observations, with postconditions and checkpoints; avoid fixed whole-playthrough macros.

capabilities.title: Teacher demonstrations and provenance
capabilities.needed: Instrument teacher decisions, actual inputs, result evidence, version, context and timing; distinguish privileged state from pixel features.

capabilities.title: Offline student fitting and promotion
capabilities.needed: Curated transition datasets, source-level train/check split, small policies, failed-run retention and measured promotion/rollback.

capabilities.title: Destination routes and local avoidance
capabilities.needed: Verified location, bounded route segments, signed-coordinate math, obstacle/enemy awareness, stuck recovery and arrival checks.

capabilities.title: Combat observations and decision context
capabilities.needed: Card/turn/target recognition, resource limits, repeatable damage evaluation and observed battle outcome.

capabilities.title: Versioned game knowledge
capabilities.needed: Normalized boss/quest/gear/pet/world data with source dates, conflicts and separately verified observations.

capabilities.title: Bounded asset catalog and provenance
capabilities.needed: Repair the older best-effort script bridge; strict WAD headers, sizes and compression limits; deduplicate assets without claiming render equivalence.

capabilities.title: Patch, type and protocol diagnostics
capabilities.needed: Optional offline reports and compatibility invalidation; no automatic offset repair or game-input dependency.

sources.reuse: Combat/HUD cues as an alternative detector.
sources.teacher_role: Detector comparison; not a trusted player.
sources.required: Add positive battle evidence; missing/occluded book must yield unknown.

sources.title: Aurorium

sources.title: Cheat Engine

sources.title: GrubNinja

sources.title: Historical Maelstrom portable

sources.title: Raid utility tools

sources.title: Wizard101 Farming

operations.title: Observe and record
operations.outcome: Recording finalized with frame/input timing and declared loss.

operations.title: Auto-Idle / return to native Idle
operations.outcome: Selected method active or YOU ARE IDLE visibly verified; no conflicting input owner.

operations.title: Review Pet Dance recording
operations.outcome: Proposal pack and report saved, with original labels unchanged.

operations.title: Play Pet Dance
operations.outcome: Bounded rounds completed with independently observed result, energy changes and stop state.

operations.title: Wait for a recognized state
operations.outcome: Fresh positive state evidence or bounded timeout/unknown; absence is not inferred success.

operations.title: Care for selected home plants
operations.outcome: Selected plant need changed as expected, with bounded energy use and no unexplained actions.

operations.title: Find an item in Bazaar
operations.outcome: Item/page/price evidence returned or explicit not-found after bounded pages; no purchase implied.

operations.title: Buy a configured item within limits
operations.outcome: Configured quantity/inventory and currency deltas verified; uncertain transactions are not retried automatically.

operations.title: Choose and verify a combat turn
operations.outcome: Chosen card/target and resulting turn observed; battle ended is not automatically victory.

operations.title: Repeat a configured dungeon entrance
operations.outcome: Entrance, battle, return and requested repeat count verified; drops reported only when observed.

operations.title: Reach a selected destination
operations.outcome: Arrival and location independently verified; stuck/unknown stops instead of claiming completion from elapsed steps.

operations.title: Progress the tracked quest
operations.outcome: Bounded subgoal/dialogue/objective progress verified, with pause at unsupported transitions.

operations.title: Import and check game knowledge
operations.outcome: Validated versioned records imported with sources, dates and conflicts; existing data preserved.

operations.title: Index local game assets
operations.outcome: Bounded hashed asset index with parse failures explicit; assets are not automatically current-frame templates.

operations.title: Compare combat outcomes
operations.outcome: Repeatable estimates with formula/source version and independent fixture checks; no fabricated observed reward.

operations.title: Check affected packs after a patch
operations.outcome: Changed data linked to affected backends and requalification checks; live type attachment remains a distinct operation.

operations.title: Build a student from demonstrations
operations.outcome: New candidate pack, dataset lineage, supported context and held-out comparison; never replace the active pack automatically.

work_packages.title: Unify operation contracts and input ownership
done_when: Typed finite jobs distinguish completed, failed, cancelled, interrupted, unknown and cleanup-failed.
Native, old queue, hub and Auto-Idle contend for the same cross-process target lease.
Concurrent starts, stop, crash, duplicate job and restart are tested with fake targets; no blind action replay.
An admitted job names its exact operation, backend, pack, target and budgets.

work_packages.title: Share capture, conditions and teacher evidence
done_when: One capture stream feeds recording, observations and selected controller with bounded queues.
Freshness, geometry and coordinate conversion survive scaling and negative-scene tests.
Wait/branch/repeat/call steps use the same evaluator in replay and live adapters.
Teacher proposal, actual input and independently observed outcome remain separate, with source timing and privileges.

work_packages.title: Verify native Idle lifecycle and desktop handback
done_when: Explicit screen-menu Idle transition and YOU ARE IDLE recognition are verified.
Inputs release before handback; user desktop activity pauses without stealing focus.
Cleanup failure is visible and blocks further live jobs; restored Idle is reported only with evidence.

work_packages.title: Complete one teacher-to-student operation
done_when: Current Pet Dance cues, phases and cadence are calibrated and bounded live rounds verified.
Demonstrate mode records teacher actions and outcomes; independent varied rounds remain held out.
A native rule/template student or justified small fitted policy is compared against the retained teacher.
The same Pet Dance operation can select an independently qualified backend and return to Idle.

work_packages.title: Repair knowledge, assets and patch adapters
done_when: WAD header/decompression/size and worker-timeout defects repaired with format fixtures.
Boss/gear/pet/world imports preserve sources, dates, conflicts and stable identities.
Offline diagnostic jobs are bounded and patch changes invalidate only affected qualification scopes.

work_packages.title: Reuse primitives for gardening and Bazaar search
done_when: Interrupted gardening actions release keys and resource use is measured.
Menu/item/plant recognition handles negatives and scale changes.
Bounded home-care and search demonstrations produce reusable examples with independent outcomes.
Search does not silently include purchase; per-operation qualification is retained.

work_packages.title: Repair combat evaluation and optional transactions
done_when: Damage calculations are pure and pass independent enchant/resistance/boost checks.
Card choice and target proposals are event-conditioned, with resource and turn outcome checks.
Optional purchase operations have explicit budgets and reconciliation before any retry.

work_packages.title: Build verified routes and composed quest/farming routines
done_when: Route geometry repaired; current location, progress, stuck recovery and arrival are observed.
Avoidance decisions react to current hazards rather than a fixed action script.
Compose entrance farming and quest subgoals only from qualified operations with persistent checkpoints.

work_packages.title: Qualify scheduler UI, recovery and delivery
done_when: W101 workspace shows available operations, backend choices, prerequisites, limits and readable run evidence.
Queue reordering, missed triggers, cancellation, restart and immutable running versions are verified.
A shipped offline operation and a shipped bounded live operation use the same job lifecycle.
Installer update/uninstall preserves routines, schedules, packs and reports; no automatic live resumption.
